Maria: Heads-up — during quant4 bring-up of 'pinedge-3b' on ded-1 we hit context-coherence degradation after long priming (~95k tokens). The model begins to echo a chunk of earlier context (around the 12k token region) when resuming. Repro below.

Liam: Can you paste a minimal repro snippet and the exact logs? Is this looking like KV eviction, index wrap, or RoPE aliasing? :eyes:

Maria: Minimal repro (toy):
```python
# prime with long system + document, then resume generation
client.generate(model='pinedge-3b', prompt=long_prime, max_new_tokens=512, use_kv_cache=True)
# later: resume with additional input
client.generate(model='pinedge-3b', prompt='Continue:', max_new_tokens=1024, use_kv_cache=True)
```
Log excerpt: 
```
KV capacity: 131072 entries
Observed seq_idx at divergence: 95023
Last stored kv_index: 12288
KV index wrap warning: true (kv_index masked -> 131071 -> alias to 12287)
rotary_phase: pos*inv_freq mod 2pi -> wrap near pos=16384
```

bench-bot: eval-runner finished /runs/20260320-1200: longctx-perf: perplexity +7% after 90k tokens, coherence-score dropped 0.12

Ash: Hmm, sounds like rotary phase wrap / aliasing. What quant backend are you using? int4v2? And are we packing KV slots differently under quantization?

Maria: int4v2 with our custom clamp. Quick test toggling rope_adaptive=false reduced repetition frequency but didn't eliminate it. Error trace shows phase continuity breaks when kv_index >> shard_size.

Nina: Quick idea — check whether we store absolute position or shard-local offsets in the KV key. We had a bug where high bits got masked when combining shard offset + local index; that can cause aliasing across windows.

Maria: Good call. I changed kv_index_mask from 0x1FFFF to 0x3FFFF locally and re-ran. Early results: repetition gone on the same seed. Running a broader sweep now.

ci-bot: Canary rollout: ded-1 pool updated with kv-index-mask patch on 3 GPUs. Health checks: 3/3 ok, no OOMs.

Liam: If this fixes it, add a unit/integration test: prime past window edge, flush some shards, then resume — assert ngram overlap with the priming segment < 1%. Also add a monitor in longctx suite that runs weekly.

Maria: Will add test to longctx-regressions: test name 'rollover_continuity_smoke' — steps:
- prime 100k tokens
- resume generation at +512 tokens
- compute top-3 ngram overlap against last 20k tokens of prime -> assert < 1%

Ash: Also flagging that pinecone-v2 showed a perf dip around the same offsets when quantized and packed — might be related to KV packing math. I'll follow up tomorrow with a microbench.

Maria: Thanks all. Posting the raw run artifacts: s3://redwood-dev/runs/pinedge/3419990000/artifacts.tar.gz. Will update thread after sweep completes. :thumbsup:
